scope: Independent exact-code and synthetic/fixed-16-TRAIN preflight review. One approved protocol fit only after separately bound FIT_AUTHORIZATION and fresh CPU admission; no run performed by reviewer.
conditions: Executor must write a dated FIT_AUTHORIZATION with approved=true, one_run=true and exact review/protocol/source-seal hashes under root standing authorization.

Fresh admission must pass; maximum 8 CPUs, 16 GiB address-space/RSS envelope and total four-hour features/fit/evaluation budget. Resource exhaustion is INCOMPLETE_RESOURCE, no retuning, extension or partial-forest score.
Single full TRAIN fit only; validation follows frozen forest/schema/target-scale/TRAIN-ID artifact. Exactly standalone D and fixed half-D/half-F5. No test.
All runtime forests, feature tables and prediction arrays remain server-only.
limits: A successful 16-row/synthetic preflight does not establish full-data fit feasibility; resource gates remain mandatory.
Geometry graph is a deterministic Z+coordinate representation with no bond order/aromaticity labels.
The result tests this fixed descriptor/learner combination only; reused-validation bootstrap is descriptive.
Watchdog resource accounting is sampled; RLIMIT_AS is a hard per-process bound and CPU affinity limits execution to eight selected logical CPUs.
